card.name: Split-up words in all-caps warnings
card.fires_on: The first piece of a long word broken apart in ALL-CAPS label text, most often " OCC" in "OCCURS" after "allergic reaction to [drug]".

modes.label: OCC before URS
modes.description: The piece " OCC" starting "OCCURS" right after an allergic reaction clause in capitalized warnings.
modes.example: IF AN ALLERGIC REACTION TO CEFOTETAN<< OCC>>URS, DISCONTINUE THE DR

modes.label: Other capitalized word starts
modes.description: Short opening pieces of other capitalized words such as CONCOMITANT, FLUIDS or CO-INFECTED.

card.writes: It seems to push the model away from the usual word endings and toward other continuations, so the effect is unclear.
card.plain: It fires on the opening piece of a long capitalized word, mainly OCCURS in allergy warnings.
